result.what_interviewer_wanted: They wanted a clear definition of Docker, explanation of containerization, and why it solves deployment issues, with mention of images, containers, Dockerfile, and benefits over VMs.
result.improved_answer: Docker is a platform that packages an application and its dependencies into a lightweight, portable image. When you run that image, you get a container that behaves the same on any host, solving the “works on my machine” problem. A Dockerfile defines how the image is built, and containers share the host kernel, making them lighter than full virtual machines.
